python.title: Meet Python
python.description: Where Python came from, how it actually runs your code, what it is used for, how to set it up, and where to find answers.

Setting Up: Python, the REPL and VS Code

lessons: Your First Programs: print() and Comments

python.title: Working with Text
python.description: String methods in depth, f-string formatting, Unicode and bytes, and regular expressions.

python.title: Modules, Packages and Tools
python.description: Imports and modules, a tour of the standard library, virtual environments and package managers, and structuring a real project.
lessons: A Tour of the Standard Library

python.title: Object-Oriented Python
python.description: Classes and objects, methods, inheritance and composition, special methods, properties, dataclasses, enums, ABCs and protocols.
lessons: Special Methods: Making Your Objects Pythonic

python.title: Python Under the Hood
python.description: The object model, memory management, advanced typing, descriptors and metaclasses, bytecode and performance.
lessons: Everything Is an Object: Identity, Mutability and Copying

pyml.title: The AI and ML Landscape
pyml.description: A history of AI, what machine learning really is, the Python ML ecosystem, and setting up a GPU-ready environment.
lessons: A History of AI and Machine Learning
Setting Up: GPUs, CUDA, Notebooks and Environments

pyml.title: The Math You Need
pyml.description: Vectors, matrices and tensors; derivatives, gradients and the chain rule; and the probability behind every model.
lessons: Derivatives, Gradients and the Chain Rule

pyml.title: NumPy
pyml.description: Fast numerical arrays: creation, indexing, vectorization, broadcasting, linear algebra and random numbers.
lessons: Linear Algebra and Random Numbers in NumPy

pyml.description: pandas DataFrames, plotting with matplotlib, and preparing data so models can learn from it.

pyml.title: Classic Machine Learning
pyml.description: Regression, classification, evaluation, regularization, tree ensembles and unsupervised learning with scikit-learn.
lessons: Overfitting, Regularization and the Bias–Variance Tradeoff
Decision Trees, Random Forests and Gradient Boosting

pyml.description: Neurons and activations, loss and gradient descent, backpropagation, and a complete neural network written in NumPy.

pyml.description: Tensors and GPUs, autograd, nn.Module, the training loop, datasets and data loaders, and saving and exporting models.

pyml.title: Deep Learning
pyml.description: Convolutional networks, the tricks that make deep networks train, sequence models, attention and transformers, and transfer learning.
lessons: Training Deep Networks: Normalization, Dropout and Schedules

pyml.description: Agents and rewards, MDPs, Q-learning, Gymnasium, deep Q-networks, policy gradients, and PPO with Stable-Baselines3.
lessons: Markov Decision Processes and Value Functions

RLGym: Building a Rocket League Environment

Running Trained Models in a Game Engine

pyml.title: Applied AI Projects
pyml.description: LLM APIs, embeddings and retrieval, practical computer vision, serving models, and an end-to-end capstone.

tkinter.title: Meet tkinter
tkinter.description: What tkinter is and what it is for, how a window comes to life, and the event loop that every GUI program is built around.
lessons: What tkinter Is and What It Is For

tkinter.title: Widgets
tkinter.description: The building blocks of an interface: labels and buttons, text entry, checkboxes, radio buttons, sliders, tk variables, lists and scrollbars.

tkinter.description: Placing widgets in a window: pack, grid and place, frames to group things, and layouts that resize gracefully.

lessons: Binding Events: Keys, Mouse and Focus
Standard Dialogs: Messages, Files and Colors

tkinter.description: The Canvas for drawing and animation, the modern ttk widgets (Treeview, Notebook, Progressbar), fonts, colors, images and styling.

tkinter.description: Structuring a GUI with classes, separating logic from the interface so it can be tested, a text editor project, packaging an .exe, and a database-backed capstone.

pygame.title: Meet pygame
pygame.description: What pygame is and what it is for, setting it up, opening a window, and the game loop that drives every game.
lessons: What pygame Is and What It Is For

pygame.description: Handling the keyboard and mouse, drawing shapes, Rect objects, moving things smoothly, frame-rate independence and vectors.

pygame.description: Loading and transforming images, rendering text, playing sound and music, and animating with sprite sheets.

pygame.title: Sprites, Collisions and a First Game

pygame.description: Game states and scenes, menus and a HUD, tile maps and cameras, platformer physics and enemy AI with pathfinding.

pygame.description: Organising a game project, game feel (particles, shake, easing), saving scores and settings, performance and debugging, and packaging for Windows and the web.
